page: Amazon Web Services r9g.medium is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. Built on the arm64 architecture, this instance features 1 dedicated physical core and 1 vCPU running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. It utilizes the AWS Nitro hypervisor to deliver isolated and secure compute resources.

The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r9g.medium provides a low-cost entry point into the Graviton9 memory-optimized family, offering high memory density per vCPU without the overhead of multi-core configurations. This makes it suitable for memory-sensitive workloads with low parallel processing requirements, such as small-scale caching layers, lightweight in-memory databases, and basic data processing tasks.
